title: A test run with any untracked non-ignored file in the clone records no reuse key
goal: tests.run_key keys a run only by the tracked tree: an untracked non-ignored file that is not a .py under _tools/ leaves the key unchanged, although conftest.seed_files copies every untracked non-ignored file into the git scenarios and the sync gate allows untracked files, so a gate run after such a file was edited or removed reuses a pass it never earned. A run with untracked non-ignored files either records a key that changes with those files (their names and contents) or records none; which of the two is the operator's gate untracked-key. Found by the SP-evkj4avq review in _tools/tests.py untracked_tools and run_key after ST-r7cftjex.

run: import os,sys,atexit;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import tests as t;p=os.path.join(t.KB,'zz-reuse-probe-%d.txt'%os.getpid());atexit.register(lambda:os.path.exists(p) and os.remove(p));f=lambda c:(open(p,'w').write(c),t.run_key(['-k','x']))[1];k1,w1=f('a');k2,w2=f('b');ok=k1 is None or k1!=k2;print('untracked file keyed: first',k1,w1,'after edit',k2,w2,'ok',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

Gate untracked-key options: hash-untracked = run_key adds each untracked non-ignored file's path and content hash (the set conftest.seed_files copies) to the key, so a run with intake drafts in the checkout still records a correct reuse key and an edit to one changes it (recommended: matches the sprint goal's wording, and intake drafts sit untracked in this checkout most of the time); no-key = any untracked non-ignored file leaves the run without a key, as an untracked .py under _tools/ does now, so the gate never reuses while drafts sit there.
